{{Quote|The Minister of Logistics is making sure the war effort is well supplied.|Nigh informs a customer on supplying efforts|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Nigh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who earned the rank of [[Imperial Agent]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Intelligence division]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the war he was stationed on board [[Vaiken Spacedock]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]], where he worked in the supplies section and sold equipment to other Imperials. While working he wore [[Color/Legends|red]] and gold colored [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nigh was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game he serves as an Imperial operations gear vendor within the Imperial fleet. He was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
